note: Canonical connections clause vectors — pins the guardian producer (TS: connectionsToGrant) ↔ warden (Rust: GrantConnections parse + evaluate_connections). `wifi` is saved | secured | any (saved = only networks already on the phone; secured = new networks only with a password; any = no limit). `bluetooth` is paired | any (paired = only devices already paired). Turning either radio on and off is never governed. No clause = any/any. `expect` is the posture the warden enforces. A payload in `invalid` must fail to parse; the warden then enforces saved/paired. A body `v` other than 1 also evaluates to saved/paired. issuedAt fixed for determinism.
